description: The custom tray popover (loading/tray-menu.html) replaces the native menu-bar dropdown, which macOS forces to follow the system appearance and which Tauri seals from styling. This local webview hides itself on item click / blur / Esc, so it needs window-hide; menu actions run through the app's own `tray_action` command, granted here. That grant is NOT optional: app commands are ACL-gated, and since #271 added an app manifest they are gated from local origins too, so without `allow-tray-action` every menu item would silently no-op.
